abstract: OBJECTIVE: The objective of this study was to determine whether sonographically depicted ovarian tumor growth is fractal, and the mean fractal dimension differs according to stages of the disease and histologic types. METHODS: The fractal dimensions of outlines of sonographically depicted solid components in 160 ovarian tumors were measured using a box-counting method. RESULTS: The mean fractal dimensions of the surface of intracystic solid components in serous, mucinous, endometrioid, and clear cell adenocarcinoma were 1.259, 1.243, 1.238, and 1.182, respectively. These values were significantly greater than the topological dimension of a line (=1). The value was significantly higher in stage I or II (1.381) than stage III or IV (1.205) in serous carcinoma (P = 0.02), but not significantly different in clear cell carcinoma (1.187 and 1.172, respectively). In stage I or II, the value of serous carcinoma (1.381) was significantly higher than that of clear cell carcinoma (1.187) (P = 0.03). The value of mucinous cystadenoma of low malignant potential was 1.337, which was also significantly greater than 1. The mean fractal dimensions of outlines of solid tumors in cases with dysgerminoma and thecoma-fibroma were 1.036 and 1.023, respectively. These values were not significantly different from 1. CONCLUSION: This study shows that the surface of solid components in cystic epithelial ovarian cancers has a fractal structure, and the mean fractal dimension may differ according to stages of the disease and histologic types. Fractal geometry, a vocabulary of irregular shapes, can be useful for describing the pathological architecture of ovarian tumors and for yielding insights into the mechanisms of tumor growth.
abstract_ja: 目的：超音波で描出される卵巣腫瘍の発育がフラクタルであるか、またその平均フラクタル次元が病期および組織型により異なるかを検討すること。方法：卵巣腫瘍160例について、超音波で描出された充実成分の輪郭のフラクタル次元をボックスカウント法で測定した。結果：漿液性、粘液性、類内膜性、明細胞型腺癌の嚢胞内充実成分表面の平均フラクタル次元は、それぞれ1.259、1.243、1.238、1.182であった。これらの値は線の位相的次元（=1）より有意に大きかった。漿液性癌では、病期I・IIの値（1.381）が病期III・IVの値（1.205）より有意に高かった（P=0.02）が、明細胞癌では有意差はなかった（それぞれ1.187と1.172）。病期I・IIにおける漿液性癌の値（1.381）は、明細胞癌（1.187）より有意に高かった（P=0.03）。境界悪性粘液性嚢胞腺腫の値は1.337で、1より有意に大きかった。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）および莢膜細胞腫線維腫の充実性腫瘍の平均フラクタル次元は、それぞれ1.036および1.023であり、1と有意差はなかった。結論：嚢胞性上皮性卵巣癌の充実成分表面はフラクタル構造を有し、平均フラクタル次元は病期および組織型により異なる可能性がある。フラクタル幾何学は卵巣腫瘍の病理学的構造の記述や腫瘍発育機序の理解に有用であると考えられる。
